title: TributaryEvent
description: One line of events.ndjson produced by the tributary-indexer. Each line is a JSON object matching one of the event types emitted by the splitter contract.

ledger.description: Ledger sequence number at which the event was recorded.

id.description: Opaque cursor identifier assigned by the Soroban RPC to this event.

at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the ledger close.

type.description: Event type name derived from the contract topic.

oneOf.title: SplitCreated
oneOf.description: Emitted by create_split when a new split is registered.

split.description: String-encoded u64 split id assigned to the new split.

creator.description: Stellar address of the account that created the split.

oneOf.title: SplitPaid
oneOf.description: Emitted by pay and pay_many for every split that receives a direct payment.

split.description: String-encoded u64 id of the split that was paid.

token.description: Stellar address of the asset contract used for this payment.

amount.description: String-encoded i128 total amount routed through the split (stroops or token base units).

oneOf.title: SplitUpdated
oneOf.description: Emitted by update_split when a controller replaces a split's routing table.

split.description: String-encoded u64 id of the split whose recipients/shares changed.

oneOf.title: SplitClosed
oneOf.description: Emitted by close_split when a controller removes a split from storage.

split.description: String-encoded u64 id of the split that was removed.

oneOf.title: ControlTransferred
oneOf.description: Emitted by transfer_control when a split's controller is changed or the split is locked.

split.description: String-encoded u64 id of the split whose controller changed.

new_controller.description: Stellar address of the new controller, or null when the split is locked forever.

oneOf.title: Deposited
oneOf.description: Emitted by deposit (and internally by pay when a recipient is itself a split) whenever funds are credited to a split's escrow balance.

split.description: String-encoded u64 id of the split whose balance was credited.

token.description: Stellar address of the asset contract credited to the split.

amount.description: String-encoded i128 amount added to the escrow balance.

oneOf.title: Distributed
oneOf.description: Emitted by distribute when the full escrowed balance for a token is paid out to the split's recipients.

split.description: String-encoded u64 id of the split that was distributed.

token.description: Stellar address of the asset contract that was distributed.

amount.description: String-encoded i128 total amount distributed to all recipients.

oneOf.title: Undecoded
oneOf.description: Fallback record written when the indexer cannot decode the raw contract event (e.g. unknown topic encoding).
